tools.name: analysis_run.create
tools.description: Create a provenance record for an external analysis or command run, including inputs, outputs, linked artifacts, status, and metrics.

command.description: Command line, argv array, or structured command object.

inputArtifacts.description: Registered input artifact IDs or resource URIs returned by artifact.register, not file paths. Register files first.

outputArtifacts.description: Registered output artifact IDs or resource URIs returned by artifact.register, not file paths. Register files first.

tools.name: artifact.register
tools.description: Register a file, directory, URL, or external result produced outside the app so DNAForge can track it as a project artifact with provenance. For local artifacts, use an absolute path from get_workspace or an explicit absolute provenance.cwd for a relative path. The service does not inherit the shell's working directory.

path.description: Required for file/directory artifacts. Use an absolute path, or provide the absolute workspace directory in provenance.cwd. Never assume the service shares the command working directory.

sourceUri.description: External URL or provider identifier for url/external artifacts.

cwd.description: Absolute command working directory. Required when path is relative.

provenance.description: Command, cwd, inputs, tool versions, or other run context.
